name: react-winui-workspace
description: Workspace for react-winui and its Vite documentation app.

scripts.build: pnpm run build:library && pnpm run build:docs
scripts.test:consumer: pnpm run build:library && pnpm --filter @react-winui/test-app typecheck && pnpm --filter @react-winui/test-app build
scripts.lint: eslint src/lib/src apps/docs examples/test-app scripts src/lib/vite.config.js src/lib/scripts tests vitest.config.js playwright.config.js eslint.config.mjs
